question: Can a normalized online metric-error score learner, with or without the confirmed conjunctive local trace, explain the frozen Liu behavioral map without a plastic recurrent global constructor?

claim_boundary.scope: Independent model-side sufficiency study, not a joint-training repair, compression of old P trajectories, replication of Yang-Maass equations, or renewed human posterior-comparator search.
claim_boundary.structural_priors: Fixed item cues, additive score differences, a normalized delta rule, the inherited subject-encoding distribution and (only in score_trace) the fixed local rule are imposed. Additive geometry/transitivity of the global branch is not an emergent finding. Count fixed assumptions as well as trainable parameters.
claim_boundary.human: Existing Liu data and temperature informed project development. Newly trained runs are not new human-data confirmation. No human fitting, data collection, actual participant support-order reconstruction, or human model selection is authorized.
claim_boundary.independence: Three paired training streams, not three independent recurrent backbones. Initial scalar values are identical in all runs; stochasticity comes from generic episodes. Participant uncertainty is conditional on each fitted model, not a network population CI.
claim_boundary.historical: Preserve the complete joint-training outcome and all earlier studies. Historical models are frozen descriptive references, not targets for matching internal trajectories or refitting gains.
claim_boundary.necessity: An acute L-off intervention measures use by a fitted model; the separately trained score_only condition tests whether L is needed within this fixed two-recipe comparison. A failed baseline does not establish universal necessity.
claim_boundary.biology: Online stimulus/error-dependent updates are biological inspiration; the normalization, error circuit, fixed conjunction, and outer Adam/BPTT are not established human neural mechanisms.

seeds.initialization: Same fixed constrained scalar initial values in every run. No random network weights.
seeds.rule: Execute all six final runs; no seed replacement, optional continuation, filtering, or result-dependent extension.

task.encoding: Unchanged SubjectEncodingConfig and original episode SubjectEncodingState; recover original p, never resample z across repetitions.
task.queries: All 28 unordered generic pairs with original randomized orientation/order, equally weighted.
task.information: Use original binary item cues and observed signed metric d; no true rank, query answer, learned/omitted flag, posterior, or diagnostic target in state/readout inputs. z,p are inherited internal evidence-admission hypotheses, not extra participant observations.
task.global_evidence: z gates the ENTIRE update, not just d. z=0 means no update, never a target of equality.
task.local_evidence: d * (z + (1-z)*p), with p recovered from original subject state and abs(displayed d)*(n_items-1).
task.split: Reuse the frozen reflection-canonical SHA256 modulo-16 graph split from joint-training-strategy-v1: bucket 0 validation, 1..15 train. Exclude liu_v1/liu_v2 support signatures and reflections. Same generator, cue distribution and graph budget.
task.time: Support events occur once in their given order, then query read-only terminal states. No extra presentations, query feedback, or hidden-state warmup observations.

model.global_state: w in R^15, w0=0 each episode
model.eta: sigmoid(raw_eta), strictly between zero and one
model.local_state: L in R^(15*15), L0=0; L_next=L+d*(z+(1-z)*p)*k once per support presentation
model.margin: M=global_read+local_read in score_trace; M=global_read in independently trained score_only
model.gains: gamma_G=softplus(raw_global_gain); score_trace gamma_L=softplus(local.raw_gain). No local parameter/state in score_only.
model.parameters: score_trace has exactly three trainable scalars; score_only has exactly two. Preserve original fixed local keys and writes; no learned projection, gate, auxiliary head, recurrent hidden state, extra optimizer phase or P penalty.
model.sign: y=2*correct_action-1; positive M means left higher; binary query loss softplus(-y*M).

optimization.clipping: One norm over all trainable scalar parameters of each model.
optimization.objective: Mean binary cross-entropy of combined raw margins over all queries and episodes; no auxiliary loss or regularization.
optimization.selection: Fixed final step only. No validation-selected checkpoint, tuning, early stopping, extra steps or post-training calibration. This freezes a first recipe rather than claiming optimal generic development.
optimization.pairing: Same per-step episodes, p/z, cues, support/query schedules and answers within each seed. Log numerical batch fingerprints and cumulative hash, actual Adam counters, scalar trajectory and losses.
optimization.warmup: Warmup the compiled shape on the first batch of that shape without optimizer updates; no extra RNG draws; verify unchanged parameter hashes; exclude warmup from training timing and report separately.

execution.device: CUDA required for training and candidate rollout; bounded CPU for numerical summaries and analytic diagnostics
execution.precision: float32 neural computation, no autocast/TF32; float64 statistics and analytic sensitivity audit
execution.cost: Record warmup and total/warm training seconds, per-episode inference timing with warmup excluded, peak allocated/reserved GPU memory, trainable scalars, persistent state entries, updates and episode exposure. Exact arithmetic state counts are not measured speed ratios; historical timings are descriptive, not a new head-to-head hardware benchmark.

integrity.fixtures: Non-Liu synthetic fixtures only before lock. Check z=0 exact no-op, p/z distinction, orientation reversal, gain constraints, episode reset/query no-write, fixed local-rule parity, task CE gradients and one Adam step for every scalar, paired streams, protected graph partition, independent score-only updates, and correct-sign conventions.
integrity.analytic: Float64 derivative identity vs autograd and centered finite difference at fixed x/z/order/eta/gains. Sum_t d_t*S_tq equals global margin. Identity case no later update equals direct overlap. Tolerances analytic atol=1e-9 rtol=1e-7; finite difference atol=1e-6 rtol=1e-5.
integrity.cuda: Eager versus fullgraph/default margins, loss, all scalar gradients and one Adam update: atol=1e-5 rtol=1e-4. Compare batched queries with single-query read from identical terminal states.
integrity.locking: Commit/push protocol before implementation. Commit/push current implementation, then non-Liu smoke and source/input lock before all scientific training. Jointly lock/commit/push all six final artifacts before ANY generic or Liu evaluation. Never bypass locks to choose settings.
integrity.failure: Preserve invalid attempts. Implementation-only repairs before scientific execution require new append-only witnesses under unchanged protocol. Optimization failure under a valid implementation is fixed-recipe insufficiency; no tuning using outcomes.

generic.partition: bucket zero with protected Liu graphs excluded
generic.rule: Same 256 tasks in both recipes/all seeds, sampled without any fitted-model-dependent selection.

liu.calibration: Inherited historical human-informed temperature, fixed and not refit.
liu.controls: In score_trace, query shuffle deranges canonical pair addresses within subject with reversal preserved; evidence shuffle deranges local values across support addresses within subject/block preserving multiset and timing. Never alter w, its evidence, or gains. Report global_off nonlearned to reveal local cross-talk. In score_only, unused local controls are exact identities/zero-global behavior, not counted as mechanism support.
liu.behavior: Use frozen nine-row definitions and human intervals through existing shared behavior/statistics functions; quantify every row, cohort and undefined endpoint. All nine qualitative flags define behavioral adequacy; all nine quantitative flags are descriptive and not new hard gates.
liu.historical: Read only frozen joint/staged results for seeds 2108/2109/2110 for all nine rows, probability groups and costs. No network pooling or fitted historical-model changes; different training seeds mean historical deltas are descriptive, not paired recipe effects.

history.definition: At fixed cues, z, sequence and constrained parameters, a_t=eta*z_t/(epsilon+||x_t||^2), A_t=I-a_t*x_t*x_t^T. S_tq=gamma_G*a_t*x_q^T*A_(T-1)*...*A_(t+1)*x_t is derivative of terminal GLOBAL margin wrt displayed d_t.
history.decomposition: D_tq=gamma_G*a_t*dot(x_q,x_t); H_tq=S_tq-D_tq. Preserve all S,D,H arrays. This separates direct feature overlap from future-update context, not semantic truth from geometry.
history.bridge: For w0=0, g_q=sum_t d_t*S_tq exactly at fixed encoding. Also report sum d_t*D_tq and sum d_t*H_tq; their sum equals g_q. This is NOT a full intervention that recomputes p/z after changing d.
history.summary: Within subject, report mean absolute d*S, d*D, d*H over all canonical queries/trials and separately remote pairs disjoint from the support pair. Report raw signed arrays; no slope-targeted selection, new fitted control, significance gate, or attribution of all history effects to useful inference.
history.geometry: Report global and combined Hodge structure/transitive triplets. Pure global additivity is imposed; no high-Hodge success claim.

statistics.bootstrap: Liu seed 85000+training_seed, generic 86000+training_seed. Percentile participant/episode bootstrap, paired within training seed, endpoint complete cases before resampling. No pooling or population bootstrap.
statistics.probability: Compute sigmoid(y*M/T) for each orientation before averaging; then equal-weight pairs within subject and subjects. Exact decision ties=0.5.
statistics.groups: overall, learned, nonlearned, retained and omitted learned pairs for Liu; learned/nonlearned generic. Expose denominators/excluded indices; no performance-based participant filtering outside the frozen descriptive behavior-map cohorts.

competence.measure: Mean intact exact decision, not sampled choice or sigmoid probability.

behavior.adequacy: All nine frozen qualitative rules independently in each run. Undefined fails, not dropped; all quantitative matches still reported.

local_support.omitted_contribution: score_trace intact-minus-local_off omitted correct-probability CI lower >0
local_support.query_specificity: score_trace intact-minus-query_shuffle learned probability CI lower >0
local_support.evidence_specificity: score_trace intact-minus-evidence_shuffle learned probability CI lower >0
local_support.boundary: No mandatory retained acute benefit size. Report retained and omitted probability headroom 1-p_global separately; do not assert a ceiling explanation without checking values. Positive acute use plus independent recipe comparison supports a local contribution only within this comparison.

outcomes.score_only_sufficient: score_only passes competence and all nine qualitative rows; report score_trace regardless. Prefer the simpler sufficient recipe, without global minimality claim.
outcomes.compact_dual_state_candidate: score_only not behaviorally adequate; score_trace competent and adequate, and all five local_support rules pass.
outcomes.compact_behavior_solution_mechanism_unre: Only score_trace adequate but at least one local_support rule does not pass.
outcomes.competent_behavior_incomplete: Neither recipe behaviorally adequate, but at least one passes competence.
outcomes.fixed_recipe_insufficient: Neither recipe passes competence; preserve outcomes without asserting that the algorithm family cannot learn.
outcomes.across_seeds: Same outcome label only if all three paired streams individually meet it; otherwise heterogeneous, with complete per-run matrices. Computational state reduction reported separately, not used to override behavior.

decision_contract.stop_rule: After all six fixed training/evaluation runs, freeze and report. No extra seed, auxiliary objective, gain/temperature calibration, projection, alternative cue geometry, longer training or architecture patch. Only a separately authorized prospective question can follow. Failure localizes what this fixed recipe does not explain, not universal impossibility.

deliverables: Prospective protocol and native study registration
Non-Liu integrity/CUDA smoke and source/input lock with Git witness
Six final two/three-scalar checkpoints, configs, complete logs, data fingerprints and jointly committed artifact lock
All generic/Liu raw oriented margins, masks, routing and analytic history arrays as typed NPZ allow_pickle=False
Per-run/paired uncertainty, nine-row behavioral map, history bridge, local controls, complexity/costs, frozen historical comparison and explicit outcome/claim boundaries
Registered immutable JSON and human-readable report; full applicable checks, scoped dev commit, clean worktree and origin/dev push
